name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast ratio for interactive elements while keeping the ring visible on all backgrounds. The trade-off is slightly larger focus rings, but that’s a worthwhile cost for universal usability.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring still risks blending on patterned backgrounds where #005fcc’s contrast drops below 3:1. A better alternative: use a 3px #fff ring with a 1px #000 outer ring—this guarantees visibility on both light and dark patterned backgrounds while meeting WCAG. Settle it with a contrast test on the actual EXCAVA background patterns.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt the 3px #000 outer ring with a 1px white inner ring. This guarantees 7:1 contrast on every background, including patterned ones, meeting WCAG AAA. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring, but that’s a small price for universal visibility and reliability.

name: Reader
text: The 3px #000 ring risks disappearing on dark patterned backgrounds where it blurs into the pattern. A better alternative: use a 4px #005fcc ring with a 2px white inner ring—this meets WCAG 2.2’s 3:1 contrast ratio and stays visible on all backgrounds. Settle it with a contrast test against actual patterned backgrounds.
